assignment_note: Responsible roles are planned responsibilities assigned by the lead, not Jira account identities or active agent assignments.

epics.summary: Agree the goal and understand the recordings
Try the first card reading method
Present findings and decide what comes next

tickets.summary: Agree what the first version must deliver
acceptance_criteria: Record expected attendance output, lecture identifier and review process.
Record the professor's success criteria and any unanswered decisions.

tickets.summary: Review a short sample of the lecture recording
acceptance_criteria: Record accessible sample locations and recording timestamps.
Document readable and unreadable cards, card layouts and crowded scenes.

tickets.summary: Prepare a checked set of card examples
acceptance_criteria: Create a sample list with separate card observations and manual reference labels.
Include clear and difficult examples without treating repeated frames as new students.
Check the proposed method against the observed card identifier and samples.
Record the smallest test, success checks, unresolved assumptions and decision to proceed.
Document required packages, input locations and how to run the scoped experiment.
Confirm that the setup can read a permitted test image without changing source data.

tickets.summary: Try reading student details from cropped cards
acceptance_criteria: Use the reader appropriate to the observed identifier rather than assuming OCR.
Compare exact raw and normalized results with the checked labels and retain failures.

tickets.summary: Find each student card in a video frame
acceptance_criteria: Locate separate cards when several are visible together.
Compare detections with manually checked observations and record missed or wrong regions.

tickets.summary: Improve difficult card images where useful
acceptance_criteria: First show a recurring crop, angle or brightness issue that warrants this task.
Compare the proposed change with unchanged crops and retain it only when the evidence supports it.

tickets.summary: Combine repeated views of a card
acceptance_criteria: Use relevant repeated observations without mixing simultaneous cards.
Record how unclear or conflicting readings remain unresolved.
Create one accepted record per identifier per lecture with supporting observations.
Keep uncertain cases available for review; an unreadable card does not establish absence.

tickets.summary: Check the system on a separate recording
tickets.responsible_role: Technical planner; future test specialist executes
acceptance_criteria: Freeze the tested configuration and use footage separate from tuning.
Report correct, wrong, missed, unresolved and duplicate results, explicit denominators and processing time.

tickets.summary: Write the final findings and limitations
acceptance_criteria: Explain the method, results and limitations using evidence references.
Separate card presentation evidence from verification that the card owner attended.

tickets.summary: Write clear instructions for running the prototype
acceptance_criteria: Document inputs, settings, run steps and expected output.
Verify the instructions against the tested version and note required access or dependencies.
Show the attendance workflow and measured results in plain language.
Present remaining limitations and choices for the next stage without claiming untested features.

tickets.summary: Consider checking the person against the card photo
acceptance_criteria: Reopen only after the first milestone is evaluated and Ody requests this direction.
Define requirements and a separate evidence based plan before implementation.
Reopen only after a useful measured baseline and an agreed delivery need.
Clarify iPad, live processing and user interface requirements before committing to development.
